name: Jakobsweg
description_md:
Jakobsweg is a waymarked hiking route in Austria spanning 70.4 km. It involves 1358 m of ascent and 1426 m of descent.

The route requires about 21 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule and has a hard difficulty derived from distance and ascent. It belongs to the national waymarked hiking network. The route passes Salzburg within 200 m, Archbishopric of Salzburg within 300 m, and Hohensalzburg Fortress within 400 m.
